commercial_tagline: Crafted for commerce. Designed for community.
commercial_image_caption: Artist’s impression · Commercial concept shown for illustration.
commercial_heading: A place for everyday business and community.
commercial_description: Naya Baazar is the commercial concept for Mount Valley Residency. The illustrated layout brings shopfronts together along a central pedestrian route, with shared gathering spaces and landscaped edges. It presents a connected setting for local retail, services and daily visits. Refer to the approved project documents for the final layout, unit details and specifications.
commercial_disclosure: Illustrations describe the commercial concept and do not establish an allotment, a guaranteed return or an approved specification. Confirm availability, permitted use and final details with the project office.
slip_subtitle: Keep your customer slip. Detach the draw token along the marked line.
slip_instructions_title: On the day of the draw
slip_instructions: Bring this customer slip and the detached draw token to the venue. Present the token QR at the attendance desk so the team can mark your arrival. Follow the team’s instructions for placing the token in the draw. Keep this slip and your payment receipts for your records.
token_note: Present the QR at the attendance desk, then follow the team’s instructions for the draw. Retain your customer slip.
